offers.name: HP OMEN 16 MAX 16" 240Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 9-275HX - 32GB DDR5 - 1TB SSD - GeForce RTX 5080 - Windows 11 Home - Shadow Black

reviews.quote: The Omen Max 16 squeezes a ton of performance considering the size.
some competitors with the slightly-lesser RTX 5080 GPU often kept pace with or exceeded it

praises: BBY: 'Beautiful laptop with an all metal chassis extremely powerfull plays all my games at max settings while staying quiet'
User-accessible dual SODIMM RAM + 2x M.2 — upgrade path most 16-inch flagships lack
BBY 4.06/5 across 65 reviews; 'Great performance!... price is great, especially in this AI era'
Tom's: the 5080 often matched the 5090 in their game tests thanks to the 5090 unit's CPU thermals — near-flagship FPS at ~$1,000 less
Anti-dust reverse-blow fan system and comfortable per-key RGB keyboard (NBC keyboard 92%)
complaints: Battery ~3-3.5h in user testing (BBY), same weak 83Wh cell as the reviewed config
Unleashed-mode fan noise up to 61 dB(A) under gaming load (NBC); 'bit noisy when in full load of gaming mode' (BBY)
CPU runs 94-98 C under all-core load — 275HX throttled to ~2.5 GHz/108W vs 3.8 GHz/156W on Legion Pro 7i (NBC)
16GB VRAM on the 5080 is a real ceiling for 4K ultra + local LLM work vs the 24GB 5090 tier

design_philosophy: The sane high-end tier of HP's performance flagship: same Arrow Lake-HX chassis, cooling and 175W GPU power target as the 5090 halo, but the RTX 5080/32GB spec that Tom's found often kept pace with the flagship anyway. Fits the OMEN Max brief of desktop-class parts in a maintainable 16-inch aluminum chassis.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from the NBC/Tom's reviewed 5090/275HX config (see SHARED-omen-max16.md): GPU 5090→5080 = gaming −1.5, ai_ml −1.0 (24→16GB VRAM), battery +0.5 (lower GPU draw). RAM 32GB matches the reviewed unit; 1TB vs 2TB storage is a spec-only delta. thermals_noise +0.5 vs anchor: the 5080 loads the shared cooler less. Screen assumed 240Hz IPS per BBY tier listing (OLED is the separate 19195150 SKU).
